title: Matchless Love 606 /
firstLine: It was matchless love that found me,

lines: It was matchless love that found me,
When the bands of sin had bound me,
It was love that planned escape for me
When I was lost, undone;
It was love in sad plight, saw me,
It was love that reached out for me,
'Twas the precious love of Jesus Christ
The might, holy one.
What a tender loving kindness,
That sought me in my blindness,
And a marvelous redemption wrought
That mortals might be free!
What an act in its completeness!
What a love in tender sweetness!
What a wonderful salvation now
Abounds for you and me!
What a wonderful relation
That I, in lowly station,
Am called a "son unto God," what more
Could human heart desire?
By His tender love o'er shaded,
I'll be kept till earth has faded
From my sight, and I shall enter in
To join the heav'nly choir.
Love, 'twas love, matchless love,
Love, 'twas love, matchless love
Upon the cruel cross to choose
A death of shame for me.
Love, 'twas love, matchless love,
Love, 'twas love, love I owe,
For His salvation full and free,
Giv'n thru love, love, matchless love?
